title: 75-County Geographic Dimension
does_not: Assign future roles to counties in advance
decision: Add a permanent geographic dimension inside V2.1 SEE ARKANSAS: 75 standardized county digital-twin records (same 12 dimensions), regional relationship graph, county balance sheets, geographic decomposition rule, opportunity portfolio architecture, county UNKNOWN register, and interactive map/data contract.
why: If geography waits until v3, every v2 baseline and redesign must be retrofitted. Arkansas is not one average place. Build the spine now; analyze in v2; personalize in v3.

build_method.wrong: County 1 research → write → perfect; then County 2…
build_method.right: Field 1 → all 75; Field 2 → all 75; continuous statewide completeness.

guardrails: No county ranking from best to worst.
Roles emerge from evidence; never assigned beforehand.
CC FUTURE is opportunity portfolio — not central planning.
Evidence classes: KNOWN | ESTIMATED | PROXY | UNKNOWN.
Non-blocking unknowns cannot hold V2.1 open.

version_progression.v2_blueprint_book: How could Arkansas actually apply it? — ACTIVE (uses geographic spine)
version_progression.v3_living_arkansas_book: What does this mean where I live? — FUTURE (personalized county/region experience)
